title: The optimal polynomial-time approximation of EFX
area: Algorithmic game theory, mechanism design and fair division
formal: What is the supremum α such that a polynomial-time algorithm always returns a complete allocation of nonnegative additive goods with v_i(A_i)≥α v_i(A_j without g) for every pair i,j and every good g in A_j?
context:
This requires polynomial time in binary-encoded valuations. TCS-1116 concerns the universal existence factor; no equivalence between the two questions is assumed.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Separates the efficiently attainable fairness guarantee from the purely existential EFX frontier.
